description: PATCH /crm/businesses/:businessId/contacts/:contactId honours record visibility and business membership (R0-03 review ST-A high severity, ST-B should-fix). CrmService.updateContact applies the visibility clause GET detail applies (resolveCrmAccess + visibilityClause, the PR #190 semantics) in its access check and in its in-transaction read, so a contact the caller cannot see answers 404 byte-identical to an unknown id (timestamp and echoed path aside) with nothing written and no field of the row in the body; a visible contact the caller may not edit keeps its 403; a PATCH that changes ownerId is accepted only when the new owner holds a membership in the path business (the check reassignContacts applies, now shared as CrmService.assertNewOwnerIsMember), otherwise 400 with the bulk reassign message and nothing written ('' and unknown ids included), for HTTP and system-context callers; resending the current owner is not a change. Run from apps/server against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL: npx vitest run test/contacts-patch-visibility.integration.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-13c-vitest.json, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/contacts-patch-visibility.json --report .proof/r0-13c-vitest.json. RED-BEFORE on the unmodified source at 13b7389a (tests-first commit b090af9a): 11 of 20 fail, exactly the NEGATIVE CONTROL cases (ST-A: PATCH {} and PATCH {jobTitle} 200, a bundled reassignment 403, a crm_reassign takeover 200, a my-book edit 200, crm_edit owned 403 instead of 404; ST-B: another tenant's user, an unknown id, '' and a bundled outsider 200, the system-context call resolves). allowAdditionalCases is false: a change that adds, renames or removes a case in that suite must make the same change here.
requiredCases: fixture sanity (real rows) seeded two tenants and six bizA members; the crm 'write' STAFF member gets 404 on GET for another member's PRIVATE contact and 200 for their TEAM one
